newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE holds CIS men in $736,000 clothes theft case.
newsitem.headline: UAE holds CIS men in $736,000 clothes theft case.

text.p: Police in the United Arab Emirates arrested a Russian, a Chechen and two Uzbeks on charges of stealing $736,000 in designer clothes from a shop, a newspaper said on Friday.

The daily Gulf News quoted Sharjah criminal police director Captain Sultan al-Nuaimi as saying the four had confessed to the 2.7 million dirham ($736,000) clothes theft and admitted stealing another one million dirhams worth of electronics equipment during their two-month stay.
Police were able to seize the clothes before they were sent by air cargo to Azerbaijan, al-Nuaimi said.
The four faced three to 15 years in jail for breaking into the clothes shop on Tuesday night, he added.
The manager of the shop in UAE-member Sharjah told the English-language newspaper he did not intend to install an alarm system as it was the first time in 10 years his store had been robbed.

Large numbers of tourists from the Commonwealth of Independent States visit the UAE to take advantage of the country's duty-free markets in electronics, textiles and household goods. ($1=3.67 dirhams)
